information: # **This is a series competition with [Ohio State Fall Scarlet 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateFallScarlet2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Ohio State Fall Scarlet 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected.** This competition will take place in the Great Hall Meeting Room, which is on the first floor near the east side. For those not competing in the 4BLD/5BLD, doors to the room will remain closed until the end of the event (10:20am EST), at which other competitors will be let in to set up.
